Generally, people are very quick to criticize,  but few give praise where it’s due.

We’re all aware of the many difficulties faced by the NHS at the moment - budgetary constraints, shortage of staff, an increasing population etc but our personal experience is that despite all these problems and very long waiting lists at hospitals, this GP practice has done its very best for our family over the years.

We personally, have no complaints at all about the doctors, other health professionals who work at this surgery or the Reception team.

We accept that living in a densely populated area, our health concerns are triaged and if it’s deemed urgent, we have nearly always been seen quickly and appropriate action taken. If the problem isn’t urgent, we’ve been happy to wait to talk to a doctor.

Both Dr Fenuyi and Dr Oginni have always been caring, compassionate, listened to our concerns, made appropriate referrals if necessary and provided excellent care with follow up telephone calls when needed.

This high level of care and expertise was also shown by a locum doctor and the wider team of health professionals employed by Whitehouse surgery.

Similarly, we have also had a good experience with the Reception team at this practice, who have been polite, helpful and efficient and if there have been any queries or problems which needed addressing, they have always done their best to do so.

Thank you to everyone at this practice.",null,[0,227]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21wcFFYWmtNbGhVUVhRMWVHTkpkMDl1VEhwWFZYYxAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x1a2e8cb7307b1594!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOmppQXZkMlhUQXQ1eGNJd09uTHpXVXc%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21wcFFYWmtNbGhVUVhRMWVHTkpkMDl1VEhwWFZYYxAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwis4oLeqbGTAxUJHmMBHQvMNGAQoykIBCgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwis4oLeqbGTAxUJHmMBHQvMNGAQ0pMFCAIoAA"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBUnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEZGZURUZJY3pGZlgxOWZSV2hCUkdkbU5rSjVPWEYwVmxKU1VteFZORUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpSU1VOWk4wMXFjekIzV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2sxdGNVaFRUVjlDU1cwMmRrSk9XVk4wWVRGUFdVRRAB",["0x0:0x1a2e8cb7307b1594",null,1766582322262077,1766582322262077,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/116172329397461101147/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Will","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVF1pKWhOW98SudcKJoM7TpacP70DCK7EH8wHdq4mNmB3Xx4IpN=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/116172329397461101147?hl=en"],"116172329397461101147",null,54,4,null,[1,5,1],8,["Local Guide · 54 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwis4oLeqbGTAxUJHmMBHQvMNGAQ7LoGCAYoAA"]]]],null,"2 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["I had an appointment with the physio here on Monday. Unfortunately, a GP was nowhere to be found, but I was assured that a prescription would be issued as soon as he returned - in time for Christmas Eve.

It is now Christmas Eve, and no prescription has been done.

Despite giving reassurance, the GP has not even bothered to make a note on my record nor attempted to issue the medication. This was confirmed when I phoned the surgery today. The receptionist (who was genuinely helpful and sympathetic) explained that nothing at all had been actioned.

This situation speaks volumes about the standard of care provided by the doctors at this practice.

Promises were made, expectations were set, and then nothing was done.

For a patient in serious chronic pain, especially at this time of year, this shows a worrying lack of responsibility and follow through and speaks volumes of the type of people they employ as doctors.

The only positives here are the physiotherapist and the receptionist, both of whom were courteous, professional, and clearly trying to help. Unfortunately, their efforts were massively undermined by the complete inaction of the doctor.

For six months, they ignored my symptoms, dismissing me entirely, until they finally realized—far too late—that I had a fibroid polyp causing all my issues. That level of negligence isn’t just careless, it’s dangerous.

To make matters worse, they outright ignored my documented penicillin allergy and prescribed it to me anyway. I was the one who caught their mistake—not a nurse, not a doctor, me. When I called to confirm, the nurse simply glanced at my records and casually admitted, "Oh yeah, I can see you’re allergic. Strange that it was prescribed." Strange? No, it’s reckless and inexcusable. If I had blindly trusted my GP—as patients should be able to—I could have had a severe reaction. The sheer incompetence here is appalling.

Rather than taking accountability, a doctor had the audacity to call me separately after my appointment—not to apologize, but to scold me, saying it was somehow my responsibility to ensure my allergies were correctly recorded. If they can’t even manage the most basic patient safety protocols, how can they be trusted with anyone’s health? How many others have been put at risk because of their sheer negligence?

The level of rudeness and dismissiveness from the reception staff is shocking. I was yelled at over the phone simply because I declined an appointment time that I had repeatedly stated I couldn’t do—both verbally and in writing. I am self-employed and work nights; I cannot afford to miss work, yet my GP saw fit to condescendingly tell me that my job would "just have to understand." Will they be covering my lost income? I highly doubt it.

The arrogance and complete lack of empathy at this practice is staggering. They don’t listen to patients, they don’t care about patients, and they certainly don’t bother with even the bare minimum of human decency. Walking into this surgery is like stepping into an alternate reality where the people meant to help you actively make your life harder. I was consistently treated like an inconvenience—like dirt under their shoe—every single time I called or entered the building.

And let’s not forget the complete lack of support for immigrants. I have only lived in this country for two years, and navigating the NHS has been made significantly harder by this surgery’s refusal to provide even the smallest effort in explaining anything. The only reason I was able to get anywhere was because my British husband had to repeatedly step in as my advocate—because they would rather dismiss me than do their jobs properly.
